$comment: NG EarSafe AI-first operating spine. The PreToolUse hook is the technical backbone of the draft-everything policy: every live-mutation tool is denied unless NG_EXECUTE=1, which only the /execute-approved command sets. Department agents and the orchestrator draft to Company_OS/APPROVALS_QUEUE.md; nothing goes live until a human approves and runs /execute-approved.

hooks.command: if [ "$NG_EXECUTE" = "1" ]; then exit 0; else echo 'BLOCKED by NG EarSafe approval gate: live mutations only run via /execute-approved (NG_EXECUTE=1). Draft this action to Company_OS/APPROVALS_QUEUE.md instead, then have a human approve it.' >&2; exit 2; fi
echo 'NG EarSafe AI-first OS active. Read order: Company_OS/COMPANY_STATE.md -> the relevant departments/<dept>/ triad -> draft to APPROVALS_QUEUE.md. No live writes outside /execute-approved.'
